notes: Single source for CFD run presets, panel field metadata and estimate calibration (building-energy-cfd-p2-contract.md S8).
Contract bounds and the compute hard cap stay in code (cfd_options.REQUEST_FIELD_BOUNDS, CFD_MAX_CELLS_PER_DIRECTION); this file never widens them.
The standard preset must reproduce the service defaults exactly; changing a value here changes the service default and needs an owner decision.

description.zh: 與目前服務預設完全相同，也是 181 上 16 向 run 使用的設定。精度等級仍是 screening，只作設計比較。
description.en: Identical to the current service defaults and the settings of the 16-direction run on 181. Accuracy stays at screening: design comparison only.

help.en: Wind speed at the reference height.

help.zh: U_ref 所在的高度，用來建立入流的大氣邊界層剖面。
help.en: Height of U_ref; sets the atmospheric boundary-layer inlet profile.

help.zh: 0.5 m 約為市郊到都市地況；同時影響入流剖面與地面壁函數。
help.en: 0.5 m is roughly suburban to urban terrain; drives both the inlet profile and the ground wall function.

help.zh: IFC 沒有可靠真北時，風向會相對 project north。
help.en: Without a reliable IFC true north, wind directions are relative to project north.

help.zh: 由 project north 逆時針轉到真北的角度。
help.en: Angle from project north anticlockwise to true north.

help.zh: 留空為自動：樓高 ÷ 6，限制在 1.5 到 6 m。近建物格是背景格 ÷ 4，加細盒格是背景格 ÷ 2；這一階段比例固定，外圍放粗要等引擎新參數。
help.en: Empty means automatic: building height / 6, clamped to 1.5-6 m. Near-building cells are background / 4 and refinement-box cells background / 2; the ratio is fixed until the engine gains far-field coarsening.

help.zh: 未達收斂時會自動延長一次到 2 倍。
help.en: Extended once to twice the value when residual control is not reached.
